policies: XULAN approved client-communication policy: Warm, restrained contemporary Eastern design, Chinese conversational WeChat drafts. No invented intimacy, gender or family assumptions. No independent discounts, gifts, price matching, instalments, shipping benefits, stock holds or reservations. No default promotion. Viewing/inspection can be requested but times and outcomes require confirmation. Never promise refunds, free repairs, turnaround, investment/resale value, certifications, scarcity, stock, waterproofing or device fit unless verified. Never disparage other sellers or shame budgets. For cowhide avoid soaking, heat and prolonged sun; blot dampness gently with a soft dry cloth and air dry. No alcohol, solvents or home conditioning. Woven panels need product-specific inspection advice. Greetings contain no sales pitch. Respect opt-outs and only use relevant voluntarily supplied facts.
